description:
Build the electrical netlist from a schematic — the flat connectivity of every component pin and net, the way KiCad's netlist export works.

Use this to turn a schematic description into machine-readable connectivity: which pins share a net, what each component connects to, and which pins are left unconnected. Feed the result to erc_run for rule checking, or to a BOM/PCB step.

INPUT: `schematic` — { title?, components: [{ reference, value?, footprint?, libpart?, unit?, dnp?, pins: [{ pin, pinFunction?, pinType?, hiddenPower? }] }], nets: [{ name, netClass?, diffPairPartner?, endpoints: [{ component, pin }] }], noConnects?: [{ component, pin, reason? }] }. Field names follow KiCad's netlist vocabulary (reference, value, footprint, libpart, unit, pin, pinType) so a KiCad .net file maps onto it directly.

OUTPUT: { title?, nets: [{ name, netClass?, endpoints, components, diffPairPartner? }], components: [{ reference, value?, footprint?, libpart?, unit?, dnp?, pinCount, pinNets }], pins: [{ component, pin, net|null, pinFunction?, pinType }], stats: { components, nets, pins, unconnectedPins } }. `pinNets` maps each pin to its net name, or null when unconnected. Deterministic: the same schematic always yields the same order.

footprint.description: Footprint id from the footprint library, e.g. "Package_SO:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm".

pins.description: Pins declared by the library part. A component with no pins cannot appear in a netlist.

hiddenPower.description: True for a hidden power pin implicitly connected by the symbol. ERC does not report it unconnected.

pinType.description: Electrical type (KiCad pin electrical types). Defaults to "unspecified".

reference.description: Reference designator, e.g. "R1", "U3", "J2". Must be unique.

diffPairPartner.description: The other member of this differential pair, when declared.

endpoints.description: Pins electrically common on this net.

name.description: Net name. Repeating a name merges the nets (net labels on several sheets).

noConnects.description: Explicit no-connect markers — pins deliberately left unused.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason carried from the schematic.

title.description: Optional schematic title, used in diagnostics context.

name: netlist_export
title: Export Schematic Netlist
